article.title: Чем + nominativo
article.chapter: Nominativo y cópula cero en presente — Именительный падеж и нулевая связка

claims.summary: The phrase 'Чем + nominativo' requires clarification as 'чем' is not a nominative marker or preposition governing that case. 'Чем' is the instrumental form of the interrogative pronoun 'что' meaning 'what'. It can coexist with a nominative subject, but each has its own function.
In the phrase 'Чем Москва интересна?', 'Москва' is in nominative case as the subject, while 'чем' is in instrumental case asking about the aspect that makes Moscow interesting.
The examples provided illustrate the correct usage of 'чем' in instrumental case with nominative subjects, reinforcing the distinction between the two cases.
